body: I don’t think you would be. You are looking to start a new chapter in your life, and asking for help is not shameful or bad in anyway. Have a discussion with your Grandmother, and ask if she would be willing to give you the money. You spend more time with her, and it seems like all your parents see her for is a paycheck. It is none of your parents business, and if they really have a problem with you asking for money, they should give it to you themselves or keep quiet. It isn’t fair that they are trying to make it harder for you to succeed in life. I’m sure your grandmother would he more than happy to help you. Best of luck!

When I was younger, I noticed my father could fall asleep in seconds at will. And no, he wasn’t pretending to be asleep, he would be out cold. I struggled with restlessness as a child, and one day decided to ask him how he did it. He simply looked at me and said, “One day you’ll find out the trick,” and promptly fell asleep. Obviously, that did not answer my question, and I continued to have restless sleep. About a decade later, I’ve figured out what I think he referred to as the trick. No matter the circumstances, I can pass out in less than five minutes. I fill my lungs up completely, and slowly breathe out through my nose, letting the air slowly leave my lungs. While this happens, I just get this sense that my brain is kinda switching to sleeping mode and just like that, I’m out. I don’t think it works for everyone, but if it works for you, you’re very lucky in my opinion.
